cases.name: session carries no payload
cases.note: the session event's payload is JSON null

cases.name: view names the entry
cases.note: {entryId} with the dictionary entry id (a positive integer)

cases.name: read names the book, then the seconds
cases.note: {bookId, seconds} in this member order; seconds are whole seconds >= 30 from the reading timer

cases.name: journal names the journal entry by its ULID string
cases.note: {entryId} with the journal entry's ULID, a string (never a number)

cases.name: script names the system, the item, the mode and the result
cases.note: {system, item, mode, ok} in this member order: system is hiragana, katakana, hangul or cyrillic; item is the chart item ("hiragana:あ") or example word ("hiragana:word:ねこ"); mode is recognise, recall, read, type or write (write: kana drawn on the writing pad, #62; a client that does not know a mode ignores the event); ok is a boolean

cases.name: grammar names the grammar point, the mode, the score and the total
cases.note: {point, mode, score, total} in this member order (#277): point is <packId>:<lessonId> (neither id holds a colon); mode is lesson (a finished lesson run) or review (a review run, #181; a client ignores a mode it does not know); score and total are whole numbers with 0 <= score <= total <= 1000. Parse and replay rules: grammar/runs.json

cases.name: a grammar review run names the mode review
cases.note: the fifth argument is the mode, lesson when it is left out: review is a review run of a learned point (#181), same members in the same order. Review rules: grammar/review.json

cases.name: course names the kind, the course and what the learner did
cases.note: {kind, course, …} in the contract's member order whatever the input's (#221); kinds lesson-started, lesson-finished (with score, total and the words it taught), unit-test (score, total, passed, early), section-exam (score, total, passed), placement. Every kind, the parse rules and the derivation: courses/derive.json

cases.name: a drill answer names the item, the mode and the grade
cases.note: {item, mode, grade} in this member order: one answer in a drill, type drill.<id> (one type per drill). Ids, item keys, parsing, schedules and rounds: drills/

cases.name: 29.9 s flush to nothing and are kept for the next flush
cases.note: flush returns whole seconds only from 30 on; below that it returns 0 and keeps the time

cases.name: exactly 30 s is one event of 30
cases.note: 30 whole seconds is the smallest read event

cases.name: a 10-minute gap between activity pings counts 120 s
cases.note: a gap longer than the idle cut-off counts as the cut-off (120 s)

cases.name: hidden time does not count
cases.note: hiding credits the gap up to the hide, then nothing accrues until visible; activity while hidden is ignored; time counts again from the moment the page is visible

cases.name: the fraction of a second is kept for the next flush
cases.note: flush takes whole seconds; the remaining milliseconds stay accrued

cases.name: a clock that goes backwards adds nothing
cases.note: only a later ping credits time

cases.name: unchanged text never emits
cases.note: a save that did not change the text records nothing and does not use up the day

cases.name: once per entry per learner day
cases.note: the second change of the same entry on the same learner day emits nothing; another entry emits

cases.name: the learner day follows the zone history
cases.note: after a change to Asia/Tokyo the day turns at 15:00Z: 14:00Z and 15:05Z are two learner days, 20:00Z the same as 15:05Z

cases.name: read payloads: seconds and points per event
cases.note: 0 unless seconds is a finite number >= 30; seconds counted min(seconds, 7200); points min(ceil(seconds / 300), 24)

cases.name: reading totals: a read without bookId counts under the unknown book
cases.note: a restore removes bookId when the book is unknown; the time still counts, per book under null, listed after the known books on a tie
